rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments regarding the moderation of core inflation to 3.60%, I remain firm that the headline CPI at 5.10% is still uncomfortably distant from our 4.00% target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.30% poses a tangible risk of unanchoring inflation expectations, particularly when the output gap is positive at 0.50%. Monetary policy must remain focused on the durability of disinflation; shifting to a neutral stance now would be premature and could undermine the credibility we have built. I am open to compromise on the stance only if we see a sustained, broad-based decline in headline inflation towards the target, but for now, the withdrawal of accommodation remains the appropriate policy signal to ensure that liquidity conditions remain aligned with our price stability mandate.
